source: ESPN live injury report (site.api.espn.com/.../nfl/injuries) - see get_espn_injuries.py
methodology_note: Real, disclosed scope: confirmed Out/Injured Reserve players are shown with adjusted_projected_ppr=0.0 (a real fact - they won't play). Questionable players are flagged but NOT numerically adjusted - no real, fit model exists in this project for how much a game-status designation should reduce a projection, so none was invented. Backup players are NOT boosted for the same reason - no real model exists for how much workload/points a backup absorbs when a starter is out. This is a real, separate overlay - it does not modify player_props_2026.json, fantasy_rankings_2026.json, games_2026.json, or data/locked_predictions/.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.source_note: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that Mayfield (thumb) is expected to miss three weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.source_note: Colts head coach Shane Steichen reiterated Monday that Pierce didn't undergo surgery on his left heel and is continuing to rehab the injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.source_note: The Giants officially placed Dart (knee) on injured reserve Thursday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

players.name: De'Von Achane
players.source_note: The Dolphins placed Achane (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.source_note: The Bengals placed Iosivas (thumb) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.source_note: McMillan has been diagnosed with a PCL sprain in his left knee, Jenna Laine of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Demarcus Robinson
players.source_note: The 49ers placed Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Arian Smith
players.source_note: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

players.name: Jack Bech
players.source_note: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak confirmed Monday that Bech (forearm) is slated to be placed on injured reserve, Paul Gutierrez of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Josh Oliver
players.source_note: Oliver was diagnosed with a torn biceps following an MRI on Monday and is expected to undergo surgery in the coming days, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.source_note: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) returning to practice next week is potentially "on the table," Corbin Smith of SI.com reports.

players.name: Josh Allen
players.source_note: Bills head coach Joe Brady downplayed any concern about Allen's health after the quarterback took a hit to his knee area during the fourth quarter of Sunday's 24-16 win over the Chargers, Alex Brasky of SI.com and Alec White of the team's official site report. "We're gonna have to see how [Allen] progresses these next couple days," Brady said. "Josh is always a little [sore] after the game."

players.name: Breece Hall
players.source_note: Hall is considered week-to-week after an MRI on Monday revealed that his thigh injury isn't significant as feared, Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter of ESPN report.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.source_note: Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he's "hopeful" to have Collins available for the Texans' Week 4 game against the Cowboys, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.source_note: Jefferson was diagnosed Monday with a sprained left ankle following an MRI, and the Vikings are hopeful that he'll be able to play Sunday versus the Dolphins, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.source_note: questionable

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.source_note: Coker has been diagnosed with a minor quadriceps strain and could be available to play in next Sunday's game against the Lions, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
players.source_note: questionable

players.name: Xavier Legette
players.source_note: questionable

players.name: Rico Dowdle
players.source_note: Dowdle (toe) wasn't present for Monday's walkthrough practice, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Mason Taylor
players.source_note: questionable

players.name: Jaylen Wright
players.source_note: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that he considers Wright (stinger/foot) to be "day-to-day," Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.
